scenes.title: Лицо ресторана  (The Face of the Restaurant)
scenes.summary: Backstage at the morning cooking show, restaurant owner Dmitry Nagiev forces a reluctant Chef Barinov to go on air as the public face of Claude Monet.

scenes.title: Спор в прямом эфире  (On-Air Debate)
scenes.summary: On the live morning TV show, Chef Barinov prepares a lamb specialty and stirs controversy by declaring that women are unfit to be head chefs.

scenes.title: Мужская профессия  (A Man's Profession)
scenes.summary: During the TV broadcast, Chef Barinov insists he would never hire a woman in his kitchen, claiming female cooks talk too much and lack discipline.

scenes.title: Смелое пари  (A Bold Bet)
scenes.summary: Refusing to tolerate Barinov's dismissive remarks, Elena challenges him to a bet on live television: if she survives one full shift in his kitchen, he must buy her dinner.

scenes.title: Пари и телешоу  (The Bet and TV Show)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov confronts Dmitry Nagiyev after their televised culinary duel, arguing about Elena working a shift at Claude Monet.

scenes.title: Новый шеф на кухне  (A New Chef in the Kitchen)
scenes.summary: Barinov introduces guest chef Elena to his kitchen brigade, and she immediately takes over orders and inspects cooking pace.

scenes.title: Проверка на прочность  (Testing the Crew)
scenes.summary: Elena demands faster prep work during the dinner rush, prompting Barinov to leave the kitchen to test her command alone.

scenes.title: Собака Нагиева  (Nagiyev's Dog)
scenes.summary: Max is doing laundry on his day off when Vika brings in Nagiyev dog Tyson, who grabs a hot dog near a faulty electrical socket.

scenes.title: Секрет в раздевалке  (A Secret in the Locker Room)
scenes.summary: In the restaurant locker room, Max and art director Victoria desperately try to hide Dmitry Nagiyev's unconscious dog after a freak accident with a hot dog. Victoria is terrified of Dmitry's fury, while Max tries to keep calm despite standing in his underwear.

scenes.title: Шеф на скамейке  (Chef on the Bench)
scenes.summary: Temporarily banned from his own kitchen after losing a bet to his culinary rival Elena, Chef Barinov sits dejectedly on a park bench outside Claude Monet. A curious passerby stops by to ask why the famous chef is loitering on the street in the middle of a workday.

scenes.title: Комплимент от шефа  (A Compliment from the Chef)
scenes.summary: Acting as guest head chef for the day, Elena Sokolova observes fish specialist Fedya at his cooking station. She surprises the defensive line cook by offering expert praise for his frying technique, comparing his craft to the legendary Paul Bocuse in Lyon.

scenes.title: Воспоминания о Провансе  (Memories of Provence)
scenes.summary: Elena Sokolova approaches pastry station where French chef Louis is delicately assembling gourmet desserts. Recognizing his regional accent, Elena strikes a chord by reminiscing about his native home of Provence and the famous desserts in Saint-Paul-de-Vence.

scenes.title: Тайник на складе  (Hiding Place in the Storeroom)
scenes.summary: Max and Sasha hide Nagiyev's dog among the vegetable sacks and cilantro, scrambling to explain themselves when Vika catches them in the storeroom.

scenes.title: Вежливый шеф  (The Polite Chef)
scenes.summary: Acting chef Elena treats the kitchen brigade with gentle compliments and professional respect, calmly resolving a ticket delay with Sasha.

scenes.title: Звонок Нагиеву  (Phone Call to Nagiyev)
scenes.summary: Sasha takes a tense phone call from dog owner Dmitry Nagiyev, pretending the pet is playful while secretly realizing they must urgently buy a replacement.

scenes.title: Возвращение Шефа  (The Chef's Return)
scenes.summary: Senya and Fedya debate the calm new leadership style just before an enraged Chef Barinov storms into the kitchen demanding total order.

scenes.title: Преданный Аркашка  (Loyal Arkasha)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov locks himself in his office to drink with his fish Arkasha, while sous-chef Lyova desperately pleads with him through the locked door.

scenes.title: Обида шефа  (The Chef's Resentment)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov bitterly vents about the ungrateful kitchen staff, while Lyova reassures him of his unrivaled culinary genius and promises his unwavering loyalty.

scenes.title: Фиктивная пара  (A Fake Couple)
scenes.summary: To convince Hector's owner to let them adopt the dog, Max pretends he and Vika are getting married, sparking a panicked whispered argument.

scenes.title: Новый дом для Гектора  (A New Home for Hector)
scenes.summary: Successfully charming the owner with promises of loving care and a warm home, Max and Vika leave with Hector to start their life together.

scenes.title: Строгие порядки  (Strict Orders)
scenes.summary: Acting chef Elena enforces strict discipline in the kitchen, banning smoke breaks and sending an offended sous-chef Lyova to fetch arugula from the storeroom.

scenes.title: В поисках руколы  (Searching for Arugula)
scenes.summary: Searching through the dark storeroom for arugula, sous-chef Lyova indignantly vents his frustration at being treated like an errand boy.

scenes.title: Сгоревшие перепела  (Burnt Quails)
scenes.summary: Amid a rush of delayed orders and hungry guests, Victoria confronts Fedya about the seafood station just as the quail catches fire and burns.

scenes.title: Кухонный бунт  (Kitchen Rebellion)
scenes.summary: Elena rejects Louis's sloppy plate presentation and demands perfection, driving the stressed kitchen staff toward open rebellion.

scenes.title: Две собаки  (Two Dogs)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov brings back the lost dog Tyson, only for Vika to walk in holding an identical Shih Tzu puppy she frantically bought to replace him.

scenes.title: Неожиданная встреча  (An Unexpected Encounter)
scenes.summary: Ainura tracks down Chef Barinov in a quiet storage room where he has been hiding and drinking alone, surprising him during her cleaning rounds.

scenes.title: Пора возвращаться  (Time to Return)
scenes.summary: In the storage room, Ainura urges Chef Barinov to return to the kitchen, warning him that the replacement chef is falling apart and orders are collapsing.

scenes.title: Порядок на кухне  (Order in the Kitchen)
scenes.summary: Temporary chef Elena is overwhelmed by mounting ticket delays and customer returns until Chef Barinov steps in and swiftly restores order by addressing each cook's individual habits.

scenes.title: Пари между шефами  (Bet Between the Chefs)
scenes.summary: After Elena's exhausting day managing Claude Monet's kitchen, Chef Barinov celebrates winning their wager and passionately defends his flawed cooks.

scenes.title: Иллюзия контроля  (The Illusion of Control)
scenes.summary: Watching Chef Barinov revel in his victory in the office, Max reflects on the inevitability of human errors and the common illusion that one can control everything.

scenes.title: Начало отношений  (The Beginning of Love)
scenes.summary: Talking warmly at the bar after the shift, Nastya and Kostya claim they are only platonic colleagues, completely unaware that their romantic feelings have already begun.

scenes.title: Весь мир против нас  (The Whole World Against Us)
scenes.summary: Observing Chef Barinov brooding in his office, Max reflects on how some people mistakenly believe the entire world is plotted against them.

scenes.title: Право на ошибку  (The Right to Make Mistakes)
scenes.summary: Max concludes his philosophical reflection, realizing that mistakes are an inevitable part of human life that ultimately help us find the right path.

scenes.title: Вечерний переполох  (Evening Commotion)
scenes.summary: In a humorous montage of post-shift antics, Kostya clumsily asks Nastya out to the movies, and Chef Barinov shouts passionately at the television over a football match.
